title: Gap closure by network status
one_line_definition: Displays the distribution of closed care gaps segmented by provider network status (in-network vs. out-of-network). Answers 'Through which network status are care gaps being closed?'
result_meaning: [{"pattern": "In-network providers dominate gap closure, representing 80%+ of the donut", "interpretation": "Strong in-network utilization supports cost control and coordinated care, reinforcing network adequacy for risk adjustment activities."}, {"pattern": "Out-of-network slice accounts for 40% or more of closed gaps", "interpretation": "Significant out-of-network gap closure signals potential care leakage, higher costs, and reduced ability to influence provider coding accuracy."}, {"pattern": "Gap closure is nearly evenly split between in-network and out-of-network segments", "interpretation": "Balanced split indicates insufficient network steerage, prompting outreach strategies to redirect members toward contracted providers for better HCC capture control."}]
